findings.title: Deferred accepted agent connector runs after pause or AI switch-off
guarantees: Windows pause explicitly requires timer callbacks to honor A_IsSuspended
AI switch-off retires agent flows through generation advance

steps: Accept an offered agent action and retain the queued SetTimer handler before dispatch
Pause the driver or switch AI off, advancing agent generation
Release the retained handler; _LLM_Agent_Accept calls the connector without pause/current/AI check

root_cause.description: Untracked one-shot captures old Flow; connector consumer checks neither pause nor current generation nor AI-enabled state.

findings.silent_failure: Accepted UI lifecycle completes before deferred side effect; retirement does not cancel it and a connector starts after pause/AI-off.
findings.regression_test: Queue real bridge acceptance handler; independently pause and AI-switch-off before releasing timer; assert zero connector/learning/notices; retain active-flow success control. Native extracted-owner fixture supplied but not run.

integration_disposition.WL-001: Unconfirmed acceptance-retirement policy candidate; see peer-validation.md
